(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (sep-row (find (lambda (r)
                                 (for/and ((c2 (range 0 w))) (= (at g r c2) 1)))
                               (range 0 h)))
                (sep-col (find (lambda (c2)
                                 (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r c2) 1)))
                               (range 0 w)))
                (shape-colors (filter (lambda (v) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 1)))
                                      (unique (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                                         (map (lambda (c2) (at g r c2))
                                                              (range 0 w)))
                                                       (range 0 h)))))
                (ca (first shape-colors))
                (cb (second shape-colors)))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (cond
                      ((= v 1) 1)
                      ((!= v 0) (cond ((= v ca) cb) ((= v cb) ca) (else v)))
                      (else (let* ((rr (if sep-row (- (* 2 sep-row) r) r))
                                   (rc (if sep-col (- (* 2 sep-col) c) c)))
                              (if (and (>= rr 0) (< rr h) (>= rc 0) (< rc w))
                                  (let* ((rv (at g rr rc)))
                                    (if (and (!= rv 0) (!= rv 1)) rv 0))
                                  0))))))))
